‘I am ready not to be bound only but to dye’

Richard Crashaw (c. 1613–1649)

A
CTS
 
XXI.
 13
.
C
OME
 death, come bonds, nor do you shrink, my eares
At those hard words man’s cowardize calls feares.
Save those of feare, no other bonds fear I
Nor other death than this—the feare to die.
